commentary.text: In July 2026, paid media spend for Northwind Outdoor Co. was $23,161, generating 682 conversions. Cost per acquisition was $33.94. Return on ad spend was 2.84x. Google Ads was the most efficient channel, delivering 435 conversions at $30.71 each.

In August 2026, paid media spend for Northwind Outdoor Co. was $27,256, up 17.7% on last month, generating 853 conversions, up 24.9% on last month. Cost per acquisition was $31.97, down 5.8% (an improvement on last month). Return on ad spend was 3.01x, up 6.0% on last month. Google Ads was the most efficient channel, delivering 546 conversions at $30.08 each.

Cost per acquisition was $34.20, up 7.0% (a rise on last month). Return on ad spend was 2.81x, down 6.7% on last month. Google Ads was the most efficient channel, delivering 505 conversions at $30.45 each.

In October 2026, paid media spend for Northwind Outdoor Co. was $28,089, up 8.7% on last month, generating 849 conversions, up 12.4% on last month. Cost per acquisition was $33.08, down 3.3% (an improvement on last month). Return on ad spend was 2.91x, up 3.5% on last month. Google Ads was the most efficient channel, delivering 548 conversions at $30.82 each.
